subject: EU sovereign operations crediting and HSM attestation path
messages:
From: Dr. Silvia Rojas <s.rojas@olivetech.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@olivetech.com, alex.byrne@olivetech.com
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 08:12:00 +0100
Subject: Initial ask — EU sovereign controls + HSM attestation and crediting

Jonas —

Thanks for the quick intro earlier this week. OliveTech is evaluating a pilot to ingest EU patient-like data (PMS/test telemetry) and we need a clear commercial structure for the following add-ons:

- KMS (customer-managed keys) with HSM-backed key storage and attestation
- Audit logs (immutable retention options up to 7 years)
- Data residency (EU region lock + proof of replica locations)

Two commercial questions we need resolved before procurement can proceed:
1) Do you price KMS/HSM as a seat/license, a per-key monthly fee, or blended into committed throughput?
2) Do you offer an "ops credit" that offsets part of one-time implementation fees if we commit to a 12–24 month Dedicated capacity contract?

Please attach any pricing matrix you have (we will share with finance). We also need a short note on attestation timelines — our security team requires an HSM attestation statement before go-live.

Attached: OliveTech_requirements_20270711.pdf

Regards,
Dr. Silvia Rojas
Head of Compliance Programs
OliveTech

---
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Silvia Rojas <s.rojas@olivetech.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Initial ask — EU sovereign controls + HSM attestation and crediting

Silvia —

Thanks, this is clear and very helpful. High-level answers below; attaching our granular sheet as well.

Quick answers:
- KMS/HSM pricing: we support three pricing patterns and can mix them per-account
  * Seat-based (recommended for small teams): fixed monthly "HSM seat" for admin operators + per-key small surcharge
  * Usage-blend (recommended for high-cardinality keys): per-key-month + per-request tiering
  * Commit-blended (recommended at Dedicated): amortize captive HSM seat(s) into the Dedicated commit and apply a discounted per-key rate
- Ops credits: yes — we offer implementation credits (one-time) that scale with commitment length and committed GPU capacity. Typical structure: 25% credit on implementation fee for 12m commit, 40% for 24m (examples, negotiable)
- Attestation timeline: we can provide HSM attestation/sign-off within 6–8 weeks after contract signature and key provisioning. We can include a provisional statement for procurement to show expected dates.

Attached: Redwood_KMS_HSM_pricing_v3.xlsx

Next steps I propose:
1) I'll draft two commercial scenarios (seat-heavy vs commit-blended) and run them with pricing.
2) Marissa, can you prepare a short SOW template showing attestation milestones?
3) Ben/Lauren, can you look at the audit log retention tiers (7y vs 3y) and a corresponding amortized cost per month so we can present 2 options to OliveTech?

I'll aim to get the scenarios back by EOD Friday.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive — EU
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_KMS_HSM_pricing_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, Dr. Silvia Rojas <s.rojas@olivetech.com>

Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 10:22:00 +01:00
Subject: SOW and attestation milestone draft

Hi Silvia / team —

Attaching a short SOW draft and a milestone table for the HSM attestation. Key points:
- Milestone 1 (Provisioning): 2 weeks post-signature — KMS integration + key exchange testing
- Milestone 2 (HSM onboarding): 3–4 weeks — HSM provisioning and internal attestation tests
- Milestone 3 (Third-party attestation): 6–8 weeks — independent attestation report delivered to OliveTech (PDF)

We recommend the commit-blended pricing for Dedicated customers because it keeps monthly costs flat and simplifies audit evidence mapping. However, we included a seat-based worked example if you prefer an Opex-only model.

Attachment: SOW_draft_for_olive_20270715.docx

Marissa Cole
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

From: Alex Byrne <alex.byrne@olivetech.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Dr. Silvia Rojas <s.rojas@olivetech.com>, procurement@olivetech.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 11:37:00 +01:00
Subject: Clarifications on cost split and accounting treatment

Team —

A few procurement questions after reviewing the attachments:
1) For commit-blended, can you show a clear amortization example that maps the implementation credit across the first 12 months for our finance team? We need to understand the monthly P&L impact.
2) For audit logs we will likely choose the 7-year retention, but we need to know if logs are exportable in a self-service CSV (for audits) and if retention deletion is reversible by the customer.
3) HSM attestation: will Redwood accept our third-party auditor or do you require Redwood's preferred vendor?

If you can send a short note addressing 1–3 we can put together a fast-track PO.

Regards,
Alex Byrne
Senior Procurement Manager
OliveTech

---
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Alex Byrne <alex.byrne@olivetech.com>, Dr. Silvia Rojas <s.rojas@olivetech.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2027 16:45:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Clarifications on cost split and accounting treatment

Alex —

Thanks — answers inline:

1) Amortization example (commit-blended):
- Example deal: 24m Dedicated commit with a one-time implementation fee of €120k.
- Ops credit: 40% => €48k credit applied to implementation fee. Net implementation fee = €72k.
- For accounting: we can provide a monthly amortization schedule that shows the €72k capitalized and expensed over the first 12 months (server-side implementation deliverables). We will include a sample ledger export your accountant can import.

2) Audit logs:
- Export: yes — CSV export available for the full retention window.
- Deletion: retention policies are customer-controlled; soft-delete for 30 days and you can request emergency retention hold via Governance API. For true immutable retention (regulatory hold), we support write-once WORM configuration (extra one-time setup).

3) HSM attestation vendor:
- We are flexible. Redwood has a preferred lab (Kudex Labs) we can use for a fast-track attestation; but we will accept your third-party auditor provided they meet Redwood's scope checklist (we'll share). If you use your auditor, expect an extra 2 weeks for scheduling.

Next steps:
- Ben will push a 2-column pricing table (seat vs commit-blend) and an attached amortization schedule by Monday morning.
- Marissa will update the SOW with the accountant-friendly amortization and WORM options.

If that sounds good I can follow with a clean slidedeck for your CFO.

Best,
Jonas
Senior Account Executive — EU
Redwood Inference

Attachment references: Redwood_KMS_HSM_pricing_v3.xlsx, SOW_draft_for_olive_20270715.docx
